message: Command `grep -rn "fnv_32a_buf" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libass/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".git"` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: I can see the issue. The `STRING(member)` macro calls `fnv_32a_buf(p->member.str, p->member.len, hval)`. If `p->member.len` is 0 (empty string), then `fnv_32a_buf` is called with a zero-length buffer. Let me look at the `fnv_32a_buf` implementation.
